workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 熔断器 half-open 探测遇到非网络异常（如任务取消）后 _probing 不复位，LLM 请求永久快速失败
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(net): release half-open probe after cancellation or protocol errors. Target files: src/movieclaw_net/breaker.py, src/movieclaw_net/egress.py, tests/net/test_breaker_recovery.py. - Release the half-open circuit-breaker probe slot when a request ends with cancellation or another non-network exception (including protocol errors), without treating an inconclusive probe as success or failure. - Preserve failure counts, cooldown, single-probe exclusion, and existing HTTP 429/503 behavior. - Add regression coverage for canc... (Ref: https://github.com/movieclaw/MovieClaw/pull/1294)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Android 手机 0.10.0：播放器内选集点 ✕ 或换集必闪退（Corner size in Px can't be negative）
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(android): 修复关闭选集面板时闪退. Target files: apps/android/app/src/main/java/io/movieclaw/android/feature/player/PlayerEpisodeDrawer.kt, apps/android/app/src/main/java/io/movieclaw/android/feature/player/PlayerScreen.kt, apps/android/app/src/test/java/io/movieclaw/android/feature/player/PlayerEpisodeDrawerTest.kt. Android 手机 0.10.0 播放器打开「选集」后，点击右上角关闭、点击任意一集换集（以及返回键）都会把同一个 `episodesOpen` 状态切到关闭，并在让位动画开始后闪退。logcat 指向 `CornerBasedShape.createOutline` 拒绝负圆角。 (Ref: https://github.com/movieclaw/MovieClaw/pull/1266)
